question: Should Discord subagent progress ship as a configurable core feature, and should it extend the existing status-reaction owner rather than add a parallel reaction controller?
rationale: The implementation is useful and well-proven, but the permanent UX, seven-setting config surface, and plugin lifecycle expansion require explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Extend status reactions
options.body: Add child-count and failure states to the existing Discord source-message reaction coordinator while retaining the early terminal lifecycle signal.

options.title: Approve separate tracker
options.body: Keep the parallel tracker with complete collision validation, visible diagnostics, and an explicitly supported lifecycle contract.

options.title: Narrow to typing only
options.body: Ship lightweight typing liveness first and defer configurable reactions and the broader lifecycle/API surface.

recommendation.title: Extend status reactions
recommendation.body: Add child-count and failure states to the existing Discord source-message reaction coordinator while retaining the early terminal lifecycle signal.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest connection across Discord reaction ownership, subagent registry refactors, and plugin SDK boundary decisions.
